en.title: On keeping one drawer empty
en.excerpt: A small ritual of leaving space — one drawer with nothing in it, on purpose.
en.content:
A small ritual of leaving space — one drawer with nothing in it, on purpose. Every other surface in the apartment has learned to accumulate things. Keys, receipts, half-read books.

The empty drawer is a reminder that not everything needs a home immediately. Some things can wait. Some things never need to arrive at all.

It is the easiest ritual I keep, and the one I recommend most often.
en.author: June Marsk
